Sure—I can help, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please tell me **the email address** you used when placing the order (or your **first name + last name + zip code**).

Also, if you have it, share your **order id** (e.g., “#W0000000”) and what you want to change about the two watches (e.g., quantity, watch option/model, shipping address, or payment method).

I don’t remember my email, but my name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187. 

For the watches, I want to change the shipping address to my New York address—the one you have on file from my other order. Also, I want to switch the silicone watch to a metal one. If there are color options, I’d like white.
